# VERIFICATION_AUDIT

Repository: BREVEX-CEO/caera-connect-plan. Branch `ocade/p00-p22-implementation`. Audited HEAD `02a6d3a084108c14195b9ad1eca656a2b1ac68af` (equals remote head at audit start). Source of truth: `plan.md` (v10, 3930 lines). Audit only: no product code changed, no bug fixes. This file is the only file created or updated.

## 1. Method and status definitions

- Every unit read from plan.md at its stated line range; each clause treated as a criterion. Evidence is file:line from code and test files read by the auditor.
- **FULLY IMPLEMENTED**: every clause has code and at least one test assertion (read, file:line) that would fail if the behaviour broke. Assertions were read but **not executed** in this pass.
- **PENDING VERIFICATION**: code present for every clause but no covering test assertion, or the test is platform-only or needs a live service here.
- **PARTIAL**: some clauses implemented; the missing clauses are listed.
- **NOT IMPLEMENTED**: no implementation found after the alternative-path searches recorded per unit.
- **EXCLUDED**: solely benchmarks, manual testing, cloud-computer or real-device testing, deployment, payment or launch approval, or a standing process rule with no codeable artifact.
- Documentation-only content is never FULLY IMPLEMENTED (plan 0.5). Two Part 14F tables (S14F.11, S14F.17) were downgraded from FULLY IMPLEMENTED to PARTIAL on that rule.

## 2. Counting rules (duplicates removed)

- Primary units (plan-named IDs): REQ 266, ARCH 84, SEC 208, REPO 72, UX 34, P27/28 38 = 702.
- Second-wave units (plan.md Part 6 and 14B.5/14B.6 checks, 14C.1–14C.4 ELITE/MOAT/OWNER/VERIFY, 14D.2 RUFLO/UFO/HERMES/OPENCLAW/CUA/NOD, Parts 15/18/19/21/25, owner Part 8 rows OWN-001..120): 315 raw.
- Removed as duplicates of a primary unit (auditor recorded ALIAS-OF): 40. Unique second-wave units = 275.
- Unique units counted = 977. VERIFY-01..08 in the security triage and 14C.4 VERIFY-01..12 are different requirements and are kept separate (14C.4 rows prefixed `14C.4`).
- Excluded from percentages: 102. Applicable = 875.

### Required percentages

- **Implementation (any code present = FULLY IMPLEMENTED + PARTIAL + PENDING VERIFICATION)**: 859 of 875 = 98.2%.
- **Fully implemented with test assertion read**: 162 of 875 = 18.5%.
- **Verified completion by execution in this pass**: 0 of 875 = 0.0%. No test was run in this audit, so no unit is counted as verified by execution. The earlier test-evidence ledger (docs/REQUIREMENTS_LEDGER.md) recorded 142 units VERIFIED on a different basis; it is not re-counted here.
- **Remaining coding (PARTIAL + NOT IMPLEMENTED)**: 582 of 875 = 66.5%.
- **Verification owed (PENDING VERIFICATION)**: 131 of 875 = 15.0%.
